definitions.short: to dispart (the feet or lips), i.e. become licentious
definitions.full: H6589. pasaq [ מָּשַׂק ] verb part, open wide (Late Hebrew מָּסַק , Aramaic מְּסַק , , all cut, sever, cleave ); — Qal Participle שְׂפָתָיו שֲֵֹׁק Prov 13:3 i.e. one talkative. Pi`el Imperfect 2feminine singular אֶתרַֿגְלַיִךְ וַתְּפַשְּׂקִי Ezek 16:23 (with ל person; sensu obsc.).

occurrences.englishText: He who guards his mouth guards his soul.
You have built your lofty place at the head of every way, and have made your beauty an abomination, and have opened your feet to everyone who passed by, and multiplied your prostitution.
